name: grass_plain
desc: Flat mid-green grass with subtle darker speckle. Default walkable ground; fill open fields and lay decor on top.

name: grass_flower_yellow
desc: Green grass threaded with wavy pale-yellow patches (flowering meadow / worn trail). Breaks up plain grass, hints at paths.

name: grass_dark
desc: Darker shadowed green grass with faint lighter blades. Walkable variant for forest floors/shade.

name: dirt_patch
desc: Bare brown earth with a few green sprigs. Walkable ground for clearings, campsites, grass/path borders.

name: dirt_field_tilled
desc: Ploughed brown soil in even rows. Tile into rectangles for farm plots; pair with crops_field.

name: crops_field
desc: Tilled dirt studded with small red/green crop plants. Growing field; walkable so avatars wander the rows.

name: flowers_white
desc: Scatter of tiny white four-petal flowers (transparent bg). Sprinkle over grass for meadow detail; non-blocking.

name: cobblestone_path
desc: Brown/tan cobbled paving with a lighter L-shaped stone edging. Courtyard/road surface; edge reads as a low kerb.

name: gravel_light
desc: Pale grey gravel/rubble ground with darker speckle. Walkable for quarries, cave floors, stone yards.

name: water_fill
desc: Solid mid-blue water with small white foam caps. Base water body for lakes/moats/rivers; blocks movement.

name: water_deep
desc: Darker blue open water with a shaded ring (deeper). Centre of large lakes or sea; impassable.

name: water_ripple
desc: Blue water with a curved white ripple/current line. Scatter among water_fill for surface movement; blocks.

name: water_lily
desc: Single round green lily pad on blue water. Pond accent; stepping-stone-sized detail.

name: water_lilies_cluster
desc: Cluster of overlapping green lily pads on water. Dress pond surfaces and slow river bends.

name: pond_sand_edge
desc: Blue pond bordered by a pale sandy rim. Prefab small water body with shoreline; place on grass.

name: pond_grass_edge
desc: Blue pond framed by a white-foam grassy edge. Prefab pond with green bank; interior blocks movement.

name: shore_grass_water
desc: Diagonal shoreline where grass meets water along a foam line (L-shaped coast). Land/lake corner transition; water half impassable.

name: boulder_pile
desc: Large heap of rounded foam-outlined boulders. Big 5x6 crop spills into cave-mouth/shore/gravel at edges — trim before use. Rock formation for cliff bases/blockers.

name: cliff_rock_fill
desc: Brown rocky cliff-face fill with a green grassy lip on top. Tile as the vertical body of a plateau/cliff wall; blocks.

name: rock_small
desc: Single small rounded brown rock on grass. Solid decoration for fields/paths/boundaries.

name: rocks_row
desc: Horizontal line of little brown pebbles. Low ground detail for gravel edges/trails; walkable.

name: coal_rocks
desc: Scatter of dark grey rocks flecked with black (coal/ore). Mine/cave mineral deposit; solid.

name: cave_hole
desc: Dark round opening in rocky ground (cave hole/pit). Burrow/entrance detail on cliffs/hillsides; blocks.

name: cave_entrance
desc: Stone archway framing a black cave opening. Dungeon/mine doorway; set into a cliff wall as a level exit/entrance.

name: tree_foliage
desc: Dense round clump of bright/dark green leaves — a full tree canopy. Main forest tree; cluster many for woods. Solid.

name: bush_round
desc: Single small round green bush. Scatter along paths, garden edges, undergrowth; blocks movement.

name: hedge_block
desc: Chunky rectangular block of green hedge. Tile in rows for hedgerows, maze walls, garden borders; solid.

name: bush_dead_grey
desc: Sparse grey-green dead shrub by a small rock. Withered/wintry undergrowth; crop overlaps adjacent rock.

name: tree_stumps
desc: Pair of low cut brown tree stumps with grass tufts. Clearings/logging sites; solid obstacles.

name: log_horizontal
desc: Felled brown log on its side with bark rings. Solid low obstacle for forest paths/campsites.

name: stump_table
desc: Round wooden tabletop on a short pedestal (stump/round table). Taverns, market corners, yards; solid.

name: beam_wood_corner
desc: Tall tan wooden beam bent into an L with a horizontal top arm (crane/gibbet/support post). Structural timber/hoist prop; solid.

name: plant_leafy_green
desc: Bushy bright-green leafy plant (highlight dots read almost like eyes). Ornamental shrub/houseplant; no pot visible.

name: flowerpot_sprout
desc: Brown pot with a green sprout topped by a small white flower. Windowsills, stalls, porches; solid.

name: planter_box
desc: Long low brown wooden planter with green shoots. Garden beds and shopfronts; solid furniture.

name: house_large
desc: Large timber-framed house, multiple windows, central door, gabled roof. Primary village building; solid footprint.

name: barn_large
desc: Wide barn with a broad gambrel roof and big front doors. Farm outbuilding/stable; solid.

name: tent_wood
desc: Small wooden A-frame hut with steep peaked roof and dark doorway. Outposts, huts, market dwellings; solid.

name: tower_stone_round
desc: Tall cylindrical grey stone tower shaft with banding. Cap with roof_round_orange for a turret; solid.

name: roof_round_orange
desc: Tall orange conical tower roof with a finial. Drawn over avatars; caps tower_stone_round.

name: roof_tile_large
desc: Large angled orange clay-tile roof with ridge and eaves. Covers big buildings; 'above' layer over characters.

name: roof_tile_fill
desc: Repeatable horizontal strip of orange roof tiles. Extend roof_tile_large across wide roofs; above avatars.

name: castle_gate
desc: Grey stone castle gatehouse: crenellated wall with a central arched gateway between towers. Fortress entrance/wall; solid.

name: bridge_stone
desc: Light grey paved stone deck with low battlemented side edges — bridge or plaza surface. Walkable; span water or use as courtyard floor.

name: arch_stone
desc: Low grey stone archway / open wall opening. Freestanding gate arch or ruin fragment to frame passages; solid at piers.

name: gate_arch_wood
desc: Stone archway fitted with a wooden double gate. Walled entrance for keeps/gardens; solid.

name: statue_pawn
desc: Grey carved stone statue with a bulbous chess-pawn head on a pedestal. Monument for plazas/shrines; solid.

name: statue_relief
desc: Pale stone figure set in a niche — a wall statue/relief. Mount on castle/temple walls; solid.

name: fountain_stone
desc: Round grey stone fountain basin with blue water and a central spray. Town-square centrepiece; solid.

name: fountain_basin
desc: Low grey stone basin/trough (dry or drinking basin). Water trough or fountain base; solid.

name: well_stone
desc: Round stone well with a wooden shingled roof. Classic village-square prop; solid.

name: stone_wall_arch
desc: Grey ashlar stone wall pierced by arched openings. Building/courtyard wall segment; solid.

name: cellar_door_dark
desc: Brown wall face with two dark arched doorways/cellar openings. Building base with entries; solid.

name: door_wood
desc: Single plank wooden door with a small window. Building entrance; solid.

name: door_barred
desc: Grey iron-barred door/gate (jail/portcullis grille). Cells, dungeons, fortified doorways; solid.

name: door_arch_stone
desc: Stone-arched doorway with an iron grille. Fortified arched entrance for towers/keeps; solid.

name: window_wood
desc: Wide wooden-framed window with panes. House facade detail; solid.

name: shingle_wall
desc: Wall clad in overlapping wooden shingles/planks. Exterior siding of wooden buildings; solid.

name: log_wall
desc: Wall of stacked horizontal log ends (log-cabin). Cabin walls and stockades; solid.

name: palisade_log
desc: Pointed tops of a log palisade fence. Enclose forts/camps; solid barrier.

name: chimney_stone
desc: Grey stone chimney/hearth stack with a dark opening. Attach to roofs or use as an oven/forge stack; solid.

name: hearth_stone
desc: Grey stone mantel over a draped purple cloth with a pale-blue flame emblem — a hearth or curtained shop doorway (not stairs); solid.

name: market_stall_awning
desc: Market stall with a blue-and-white striped awning over a counter of goods. Marketplace anchor; solid.

name: market_table
desc: Wooden market table of colourful wares under a little roof. Single vendor stand; solid.

name: barrel_wood
desc: Banded wooden barrel. Cellars, docks, markets; solid storage.

name: crate_wood
desc: Closed square wooden crate with plank slats. Cargo/storage for warehouses/stalls; solid.

name: crate_x
desc: Tall wooden crate braced with an X-frame. Shipping crate for storerooms/docks; solid.

name: crate_open
desc: Open-topped wooden crate showing plank interior. Emptied/loot container; solid.

name: stool_wood
desc: Small round wooden stool/seat. Taverns and workshops; solid.

name: sack_flour
desc: Bulging pale cloth sack tied at the top (flour/grain). Mills, bakeries, stalls; solid.

name: haystack
desc: Mound of golden hay beside a framed wooden panel — the 2x2 crop captures two objects. Use hay for barnyards; trim the framed panel.

name: trapdoor_closed
desc: Closed square wooden trapdoor with an iron ring, flush with the floor. Cellar/hatch cover; walkable.

name: trapdoor_open
desc: Brown wooden hatch in a grey frame over a rounded stone dome — an opened trapdoor/hatch. Opening blocks movement.

name: anvil_forge
desc: Blacksmith setup: grey iron anvil and stone forge with tools. Smithy centrepiece; solid.

name: bench_wood
desc: Wooden bench with a slatted seat and low back. Seating for gardens/plazas/taverns; solid.

name: planks_wood_stacked
desc: Two horizontal slatted wooden panels stacked (benches / stacked planks). Shares origin with bench_wood — a taller crop of the same art.

name: counter_wood
desc: Horizontal tan wooden counter/board with slatted grain and knobs. Market/tavern counter; solid.

name: panel_wood_slats
desc: Vertical tan slatted wooden panel with rounded ends beside a small log — upright twin of counter_wood (woven mat/pallet). Wall backboard.

name: fence_wood
desc: Thin run of low wooden fence rails/posts. Paths, paddocks, garden edges; solid barrier.

name: shrine_stone
desc: Small grey stone portico/shrine — columns supporting a pediment (not a lantern). Wayside altar/mini-temple; solid.

name: chain_hanging
desc: Vertical segmented grey/brown chain or rope. Dangle from beams/wells/gates as detail; non-blocking.

name: lamp_post
desc: Brown wooden post topped by a pale lantern head. Street/plaza lighting; solid.

name: table_stone
desc: Grey stone table/bench: flat slab on stubby legs (not a plank pile). Stone table/altar slab in ruins/temples; solid.

name: banner_skull_purple
desc: Purple pennant with a white skull emblem on a post. Faction/warning banner at gates/camps; solid at post.

name: flag_blue
desc: Blue draped banner/flag with a white heraldic emblem. Territory marker on walls/squares; solid at mount.

name: produce_crate_banana
desc: Wooden market crate heaped with yellow bananas. Grocer stalls/market rows; solid.

name: produce_crate_greens
desc: Wooden market crate of leafy greens. Markets/kitchens; solid.

name: produce_crate_tomato
desc: Wooden market crate of red tomatoes. Greengrocer stalls; solid.

name: produce_crate_lemon
desc: Wooden market crate of yellow lemons/citrus. Market displays; solid.

name: skull
desc: Small white human skull on the ground. Macabre accent for dungeons/graveyards/battlefields; walkable detail.

name: bone
desc: Pair of small white bones on the ground. Grim scenery with the skull; non-blocking.

name: stone_slab_round
desc: Smooth rounded grey stone slab/boulder. Lone rock, stepping stone, rubble accent; solid.

name: floor_checker
desc: Checkerboard floor tile in cream/pink and warm brown squares (marble/tiled). Tile seamlessly to pave indoor rooms and kitchens.

name: wall_brick_brown
desc: Brown brick wall with offset courses and mortar lines. Repeat to build interior walls; blocks movement.

name: wall_brick_tan
desc: Pale tan brick wall with offset courses. Tiles seamlessly for lighter interior walls; solid.

name: rug_beige
desc: Large woven beige area rug with plain border, repeating dark cross motif and fringed bottom. Lay over floor to define a seating area; walkable.

name: rug_dark_ornate
desc: Large dark rug with light braided border around a near-black field. Anchors a formal room; walkable.

name: rug_dark_medallion
desc: Large dark rug with decorative border and central medallion. Grand centerpiece carpet; walkable.

name: rug_green
desc: Green rug with ornate golden border and solid green field. Adds color to a room; walkable.

name: door_arch_wood
desc: Single arched wooden door in a frame, closed. Place in a wall gap as a room entrance; solid when closed.

name: door_double_arch
desc: Arched wooden double doors, closed, central seam. Grand entrances/hall doorways; blocks when shut.

name: doorway_arch_open
desc: Open stone archway with grey masonry surround and dark passage. Walk-through opening between rooms; passable.

name: painting_landscape
desc: Small framed landscape (blue sky, yellow foreground) in a dark frame. Wall decoration; non-blocking.

name: pool_table
desc: Billiard table: green felt top, wooden rails, balls. Games-room/tavern centerpiece; blocks movement.

name: painting_night
desc: Wide framed night-sky painting with moon and stars. Wall art for bedrooms/studies; non-blocking.

name: wardrobe_wood
desc: Tall plain wooden wardrobe/cabinet with grey plinth base. Storage piece against a wall; solid.

name: table_round_white
desc: Large round table with white draped top and wooden legs. Dining/meeting table; blocks movement.

name: window_4pane
desc: Wooden-framed four-pane window showing daylight. Mount in interior walls; decorative, non-blocking.

name: painting_river
desc: Tall framed river/forest landscape. Vertical wall art for hallways; non-blocking.

name: nightstand_wood
desc: Small wooden nightstand with a drawer, beside a bed. Crop also catches a thin chair frame on its left.

name: cabinet_wood
desc: Wooden storage cabinet with a door and knob. Wall storage for bedroom/kitchen; solid.

name: fireplace_stone
desc: Tall grey stone fireplace with dark hearth and mantel (unlit). Room focal point against a wall; solid.

name: sideboard_wood
desc: Long wooden sideboard/dresser with a row of drawers and handles. Dining-room/hall storage; solid.

name: table_round_wood
desc: Round wooden table with plain grained top. Small dining/side table; blocks movement.

name: plate_stack
desc: Small cluster of white plates or folded napkins on a surface. Tabletop clutter; non-blocking (low confidence).

name: dishes_platters
desc: Two grey serving platters holding food. Dress a dining table/kitchen counter; non-blocking.

name: props_cluster_pots
desc: Bad multi-prop crop: two white plates, a potted flower, an empty barrel and a leafy plant — not one object. Pick individual props from the raw sheet.

name: plant_potted
desc: Small terracotta pot with a white flowering plant. Windowsill/table accent; non-blocking.

name: bush_potted
desc: Small terracotta pot with a rounded green bush. Compact indoor greenery; non-blocking.

name: table_cloth
desc: Narrow crop of a cloth-draped table corner. Partial/ambiguous; usable as a cloth-covered table fragment.

name: cabinet_three_door
desc: Wide brown three-door cabinet/sideboard with handles. Solid wall storage. Crop bottom catches a second cabinet and a small frog sprite.

name: counter_indoor
desc: Wooden counter/workbench, flat top over paneled drawers. Kitchen/shop/tavern service counter; solid.

name: shelf_bottles
desc: Wooden shelving stocked with colorful bottles, jars and books. Shop/kitchen/study walls; blocks movement.

name: plant_tall
desc: Tall leafy green plant in a terracotta pot. Standing greenery in corners/doorways; non-blocking.

name: fireplace_lit
desc: Fireplace hearth with orange flames in a stone/wood surround. Warm animated focal point; solid.

name: oven_stone
desc: Grey stone oven/hearth with an arched opening. Kitchen/bakery wall; blocks movement.

name: rug_green_fragment
desc: Green rug edge/corner tile (lighter beige corner). Walkable; use as green-rug fill. Mislabeled 'painting_medallion'.

name: painting_scene
desc: Two small framed pictures in wooden frames. Paired wall art in rooms/corridors; non-blocking.

name: painting_landscape_wide
desc: Wide framed green-landscape painting. Statement wall art above beds/sofas/fireplaces; non-blocking.

name: bed_yellow
desc: Full bed with yellow blanket, white pillows, wooden frame (foot view). Bedrooms/inns; blocks movement.

name: bed_purple
desc: Full bed with purple blanket and wooden frame. Bedroom/dorm color variant; solid.

name: chair_wood
desc: Wooden chair with tall slatted back, side-facing. Pair with tables/desks; blocks movement.

name: stool_round
desc: Small round-topped wooden stool. Extra seating at counters/bedsides; solid.

name: props_wood_small
desc: Bad multi-prop crop: a paddle/board with a hang hole and a small latched crate — not one desk.

name: bench_indoor
desc: Low wooden bench/shelf, three sections, plank top on legs. Seating/display along walls; solid.

name: wardrobe_dark
desc: Tall dark wooden cabinet with louvered slats in a frame. Wardrobe/shuttered cupboard; solid.

name: stairs_wood
desc: Wooden staircase, side view, ascending. Level connector/vertical accent; typically walkable as a transition.

name: window_dark
desc: Dark wooden window with near-black interior. Dim interior/exterior walls; decorative. Crop overlaps a candle-disc sprite lower-left.

name: candle_lit
desc: Lit candle on a round tan holder with a glowing flame. Floor/table light-source accent; non-blocking.

name: cabinet_red_tall
desc: Reddish-brown two-door wooden cabinet with handles. Bedroom/study wall storage; blocks movement.

name: cave_floor_rock
desc: Dark mottled brown cave floor with rocky, dirt-flecked texture. Default walkable cave ground; tile edge-to-edge, then scatter rocks/totems/pools on top.

name: cave_floor_sand
desc: Lighter tan/sandy cave floor variant. Walkable ground for dry caverns; mix with cave_floor_rock to break up floors.

name: cave_dark_hollow
desc: Large near-black hollow rimmed by rough rock (deep wall recess). Impassable dark background pocket behind rock formations.

name: cave_wall_face
desc: Tall vertical brown rock wall face (2 tiles), faint cracks. Northern room edge; pair with cave_wall_base at its foot; impassable.

name: cave_wall_base
desc: Dark chunky rock rubble — base/foot of a cave wall. Line beneath cave_wall_face or use as a low boulder skirt; solid.

name: cave_pit_hole
desc: Dark oval hole sunk into the floor. Hazard/pit set flush in the ground; blocks movement (a fall).

name: torch_lit
desc: Small standing torch, bright flame and warm light halo. Cave light source; place along walls/paths to illuminate and guide.

name: totem_stone_a
desc: Tall tribal stone totem (3 tiles): banded carved pillar with a blocky head. Ceremonial statue; flank entrances; solid.

name: totem_stone_b
desc: Second banded stone totem variant (3 tiles). Pair with totem_stone_a to line ritual corridors without repetition; solid.

name: totem_skull
desc: Tall stone totem (3 tiles) carved with a hollow-eyed skull. Ominous idol for burial/cult chambers; solid landmark.

name: totem_mask
desc: Ornate idol totem (3 tiles) with a ceremonial mask and headdress. Shrine centerpiece / focal idol; solid.

name: rock_pebbles
desc: Pair of small rounded brown rocks. Minor floor decor; scatter for texture. Treated as solid.

name: cave_rock_small
desc: Single small brown rock with a lighter top. Floor decoration; solid single-tile obstacle.

name: rock_boulder
desc: Rounded single boulder filling most of a tile, with shadow. Solid one-tile obstacle for paths/floors.

name: rock_pile
desc: Flat-topped mound of piled rock with a small stone. Solid rubble decor; cluster for a rockslide.

name: rock_pebbles_scatter
desc: Loose scatter of small dark pebbles. Lightest rock decor; sprinkle near boulders/walls. Solid.

name: cliff_rock_top
desc: Jagged upper rim/peaks of a rock cliff (4 wide, pointed top edge). Caps cliff_rock_wall where the crest meets floor above; impassable.

name: cliff_rock_wall
desc: Broad rocky cliff face (4x2) of layered brown stone. Main cliff body; place beneath cliff_rock_top for a tall barrier.

name: rock_boulder_huge
desc: Massive 2x2 boulder cluster with a central cleft. Major solid landmark; block passages or anchor a chamber.

name: cave_mouth_ring
desc: 3x3 cave mouth: black opening ringed by boulders. Doorway/tunnel entrance; boulder ring solid, dark center is the passage.

name: cave_entrance_alt
desc: Narrower 2x3 dark cave passage with a rock cluster inside. Tighter/gloomier tunnel mouth; solid.

name: water_pool
desc: Full 3x3 deep-blue pool framed by rocky shore with foam edge and drip highlights. Self-contained impassable water feature.

name: water_rock_deep
desc: Brown rock jutting from a 2x2 patch of deep water with a foam ring. Mid-pool obstacle/accent; impassable.

name: water_edge_corner
desc: Diagonal water-to-shore corner: rock top-left, foam edge, deep water lower-right. Pool boundary corner; water side impassable.

name: water_edge_shore
desc: 2-wide water shoreline: deep water above a foam border meeting rocky ground. Bank of a pool; water side impassable.

name: cave_water_ripple
desc: Open deep-water surface (4x2) with crescent ripple marks (animation frames). Fill lake/pool interiors; blocks movement.

name: rock_islet
desc: Large rounded boulder island in water with a foam ring (2x2). Solid landmark within a pool; unreachable centerpiece.

name: stepping_stones
desc: Row of three flat stepping stones with water foam (3 wide). Walkable crossing laid over water; chain across a pool.

name: stepping_stone
desc: Single tile with a small pair of stepping stones ringed by foam. One-tile crossing to bridge short water gaps; walkable.

name: painting_framed_landscape
desc: Framed picture on the floor: cream frame, maroon mat, warm gold/tan landscape. Lean against walls in houses/shops/galleries.

name: painting_framed_portrait
desc: Framed picture, cream frame and maroon mat with a dark interior and a brown horizon stripe (somber scene). Interior wall/floor decor.

name: painting_framed_gold
desc: Framed painting, bright gold canvas in cream frame with maroon mat. Hung or leaning artwork in furnished rooms.

name: painting_framed_dark
desc: Framed painting, dark interior with a brown band, cream frame and maroon mat. Interior wall/floor decor.

name: painting_fragment_a
desc: Partial crop: lower-right corner of a framed painting. Not a standalone object.

name: painting_fragment_b
desc: Fragment of a framed painting (L-shaped corner bands). Bad crop.

name: barrel_top_partial
desc: Upper rim of a large round hooped wooden barrel. Partial crop; full object is bigger.

name: frame_avatar_round
desc: Round wooden HUD avatar frame (maroon/gold hoops, peg legs), sits above an EXP bar in the sheet. UI element, not a map prop; could double as a round wooden table-head.

name: pot_clay_a
desc: Wide-mouthed tan ceramic pot/cauldron with dark rim. Storage/cooking vessel for kitchens, markets, camps.

name: pot_clay_b
desc: Second wide clay pot, slight shading variant of pot_clay_a. Use in clusters.

name: pan_silver
desc: Silvery cookware: rounded pan/pot with upright handle (covered skillet/ladle). Dress kitchens, hearths, camp fires.

name: fragment_light
desc: Small tan corner fragment (box/book corner). Mostly empty, not usable standalone.

name: book_closed_orange
desc: Closed orange hardcover book with a heart emblem. Spellbook/quest item; shelves, desks, altars.

name: book_open_quill
desc: Open book upright: white pages, orange spine, yellow bookmark. Lecterns, study desks, libraries.

name: book_open_pages
desc: Open book lying flat, fanned pages, gold edge. Decorative on desks/reading tables.

name: rug_ornate
desc: Square grey ornamental rug with central diamond and fringed corners. Flat floor covering for interiors/thrones/shrines; walkable.

name: grave_stone_a
desc: Grey arched tombstone with a dark niche. Graveyards, ruins, haunted areas.

name: grave_stone_b
desc: Weathered arched gravestone, variant of grave_stone_a. Mix for natural grave rows.

name: flame_fire
desc: Bright orange/yellow campfire flame with white-hot core. Light/heat for fire pits, torches, braziers; animated.

name: star_gold
desc: Golden four-pointed star in a rounded gold square. Collectible/power-up or objective marker.

name: heart_full
desc: Full bright-red heart with highlight. Health/life pickup; paths, chests, reward drops.

name: heart_small
desc: Small red heart, minor health pickup or UI life icon.

name: coin_gold
desc: Gold oval coin with faint star face. Currency pickup; scatter singly or in trails/piles.

name: gold_bar
desc: Thin gold ingot/bar with rounded ends. High-value treasure for vaults/chests.

name: gem_amber
desc: Round faceted amber gem with glowing core. Valuable collectible; mines, chests, caches.

name: coin_gold_counter
desc: HUD currency-counter crop (coin + parchment bar edge), not a clean map coin.

name: meat_raw
desc: Pink raw meat/ham chunk. Food pickup for kitchens/larders/enemy drops.

name: sausage
desc: Salmon-pink sausage/bacon strips. Food pickup or counter dressing for taverns/butchers.

name: heart_red
desc: Deep-red heart with white outline and shadow (health pickup). Art is a heart despite old 'meat_steak' label.

name: bush_clover
desc: Small round-leafed green shrub in a clover cluster. Low cover on grass/gardens/forest edges.

name: bush_teal
desc: Round mint/teal bush on a dirt mound with grass at base. Exotic/magical shrub for enchanted biomes.

name: plant_sprout
desc: Seedling on a soil mound (yellow leaves, green shoot). Ground greenery for gardens/farm rows/dirt.

name: bush_dry
desc: Brown dry/brambly thicket with a few shoots. Dead undergrowth, autumn scenes, neglected wilds.

name: boulder_mossy
desc: Large brown boulder with moss and grass tufts at base. Movement-blocking obstacle for trails/cliffs/clearings.

name: pebble_stone
desc: Small round brown pebble. Ground detail; sprinkle along paths/riverbanks/rocky patches.

name: barrel_corner_fragment
desc: Bottom-left quarter of the round wooden barrel/avatar frame. Crop fragment, not complete.

name: speech_bubble
desc: White rounded speech bubble with a tail (family includes dots/!/? variants). Floating dialogue marker over NPCs; never blocks.

name: char_redtunic_hero_walk
desc: Hero in red tunic, brown hair (16x32 avatar). Full walk-cycle block: 4 frames x 4 facings (down/right/up/left stacked). Canonical player walk sprite.

name: char_redtunic_hero_walk_b
desc: Same red-tunic hero walk-cycle block, frames in columns 1-3 (first frame column empty).

name: char_redtunic_hero_walk_c
desc: Same red-tunic hero walk-cycle block, frames in columns 1-3 (first frame column empty).

name: char_redtunic_hero_walk_d
desc: Same red-tunic hero, partial walk block (down facing has 3 frames, other facings 1).

name: char_redtunic_hero_sword_a
desc: Red-tunic hero sword-attack block: 4 frames x 4 facings, white blade. Player melee-attack sprite.

name: char_redtunic_hero_sword_b
desc: Red-tunic hero sword-attack block (second variant), 4 frames x 4 facings.

name: stump_creature_front
desc: Hollow wooden tree-stump creature with green leaf sprigs and a small face, front idle. Decorative animated stump prop; blocks movement.

name: stump_creature_sleep
desc: Tree-stump creature, eyes closed with floating 'Z' snooze marks. Sleeping-state stump prop; blocks movement.

name: stump_creature_leaf_right
desc: Tree-stump creature with a prominent leaf sprig to its right. Idle variant stump prop; blocks movement.

name: stump_creature_back
desc: Tree-stump creature seen from the back, hollow rim facing away. Back-facing stump prop; blocks movement.

name: stump_plain
desc: Plain hollow log stump, light-topped rim, no face. Static decorative stump prop; blocks movement.

name: stump_creature_angry
desc: Tree-stump creature with a scowling angry face. Aggressive-state stump prop; blocks movement.
